original_abstract.text: In Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, the nature of expert specialization remains controversial. Reports of domain-associated expert preferences contrast with analyses attributing routing primarily to token identity or syntactic patterns. To clarify these differing accounts, we look beyond expert-level routing to investigate the neuron-level organization of domain-specialized computation using Routing-Aware Magnitude Profiling (RAMP), a measure developed for this analysis. Using mixed-domain calibration data, we identify domain-specialized neuron sets with 58-74% overlap across multi-source samples of the same domain, compared with 15-24% across domains. To understand how this organization evolves during training, we trace neuron importance throughout pre-training and post-training across three fully open MoE families. Neuron importance continues to reorganize between pre-training checkpoints despite comparatively stable expert-level importance rankings, while post-training largely preserves neuron rankings. Building on these neuron-level perspectives, we further introduce RAMP-based Pruning (RAMPr) to select neurons across experts for balanced multi-domain capability preservation. At 75% neuron retention, RAMPr preserves average 91-98% of original full performance across six models. At 50% retention, our pruning method can reduce resident GPU memory by 36-43% and improves batched prefill throughput by 17-39% effectively. Our code is available at this https URL
original_abstract.source_title: Understanding Mixture-of-Experts Language Models Beyond Expert Boundaries

en.text: RAMP measures neuron contributions weighted by expert routing to study specialization inside MoE models. Domain-associated neuron sets extend across expert boundaries, and neuron rankings can change even when expert rankings remain stable. RAMPr uses this finer view to prune neurons across experts. Evaluations on six models examine quality, resident memory and prefill throughput at different retention levels. Neuron-level capacity allocation could inform sparse recommenders, but no recommendation result is established.

zh.text: RAMP 用专家路由权重加权神经元贡献，观察 MoE 内部的领域分工。相关神经元可以跨越专家边界，专家重要性排名稳定时，内部神经元排名仍可能变化。RAMPr 据此跨专家裁剪神经元，并在六个模型上比较不同保留比例下的质量、常驻显存和预填充吞吐。这种更细粒度的容量分配可供稀疏推荐模型参考，尚无推荐实验结论。

original_abstract.text: Reusing key--value (KV) caches across language model updates could avoid repeated computation of shared context, but changes in model weights raise a fundamental question about what these caches preserve. We investigate direct cache reuse across four model updates, with a detailed study of DeepSeek-V4-Flash to Flash-0731. Our central finding is that caches can retain useful task information without faithfully reproducing the updated model's behavior. Retrieval accuracy varies substantially across updates, ranging from near-native performance to large losses. With source caches already available, reuse achieves median time-to-first-token speedups of $2.10$--$5.08\times$ on three longer-prefix QA benchmarks. To characterize the behavioral differences behind these outcomes, we introduce Functional Cache Divergence, which compares next-token distributions under reused and native caches. Direct KV cache reuse better preserves native model behavior in natural-text continuation, whereas compatibility degrades with increasing prefix length in single-token retrieval tasks. Answer-margin analyses help explain how correct retrieval decisions survive substantial internal state changes. Yet even agreement on the first generated token does not ensure agreement in answer content or stopping behavior. These findings establish task utility and fidelity to native inference as distinct criteria for evaluating cross-version KV cache reuse.
original_abstract.source_title: Can KV Cache Be Reused Across Model Updates? A DeepSeek-V4-Flash Case Study

en.text: This study tests whether an old model’s key-value cache remains useful after a model update. Across four updates, utility and fidelity behave differently: reused caches can reduce time to first token on some question-answering tasks when caches already exist, yet cause large retrieval losses in other settings. Functional Cache Divergence compares next-token distributions to diagnose incompatibility. The work suggests checking cached-history compatibility during model refreshes rather than assuming reuse is safe; recommendation workloads are not evaluated.

zh.text: 论文研究模型更新后能否继续使用旧模型的键值缓存。四次更新的实验表明，可用性与结果一致性并不相同：已有缓存可在部分问答任务中缩短首 token 等待，但在另一些检索设置中造成明显损失。作者用下一 token 分布的差异诊断缓存兼容性。对推荐系统的启发是，更新模型时应检验历史缓存是否仍适用，论文尚未评估推荐负载。

original_abstract.text: Recommendation systems may use predicted click-through conversion rate (pCTCVR), the product of predicted click-through rate (pCTR) and post-click conversion rate (pCVR), to guide ranking decisions. Many pCVR models build on the Entire Space Multi-Task Model (ESMM), which jointly trains pCVR and auxiliary pCTR towers using pCTR and pCTCVR losses, but deploys only the pCVR tower. At serving time, this tower may be paired with a separately trained pCTR model, creating a training-serving mismatch in pCTCVR when its predictions differ from those of the auxiliary pCTR tower. In this paper, we use knowledge distillation (KD) from logged serving pCTR scores to supervise ESMM's auxiliary pCTR tower and improve training-serving pCTCVR alignment. We denote variants by KD-$\alpha$, where $\alpha$ controls the hard-label loss weight. On the Ali-CCP dataset, KD-0.3, the best variant on serving pCTCVR, increases ROC-AUC not only for serving pCTCVR but also for pCVR by 2.1% and 1.6%, respectively, and PR-AUC by 9.9% and 8.8%, respectively, relative to the ESMM baseline. We also test negative downsampling with 5% nonclick retention. Downsampled KD-0.3 increases mean AUC for serving pCTCVR and pCVR by 1.2% and 0.9%, respectively, -and PR-AUC by 8.5% and 4.5%, respectively, relative to downsampled ESMM.
original_abstract.source_title: Serving-Aligned Entire-Space Conversion Modeling via Click-Through Rate Knowledge Distillation

en.text: Serving-time click and conversion models can be trained separately, so the auxiliary click predictor used to train ESMM may disagree with the predictor used at deployment. This paper distills logged serving click scores into ESMM’s auxiliary tower to align the product used for ranking. Ali-CCP experiments report improved conversion and joint click-conversion metrics, including a setting retaining only 5% of nonclicks. The useful idea is to make the deployed model’s outputs part of the training target when independently developed ranking components are combined; these offline results do not establish online business gains or a scaling law.

zh.text: 点击与转化模型分别训练时，ESMM 训练所用的辅助点击率模型可能与线上模型不一致，影响两者乘积形成的排序分数。论文把日志中的线上点击率预测作为蒸馏目标，监督辅助点击率分支，使训练更贴近实际组合方式。Ali-CCP 实验中，转化及点击后转化联合指标得到改善，只保留 5% 未点击样本时也有收益。可借鉴点是将实际服务模型的输出纳入训练目标，减少独立组件组合时的偏差；现有证据来自离线实验。

original_abstract.text: Large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are trained across many machines, and the way the work is split, the parallelism layout, often changes between runs: a job resumes on a different GPU count, a cluster is resized, or an ablation runs on a new setup. In exact arithmetic the layout should not matter, but in real arithmetic it changes the order in which numbers are added, and some MoE rules such as load balancing and expert capacity are often computed per machine. We ask whether the layout changes the trained MoE model. We pretrain the same small MoE language models (25M to 117M parameters, 20M FineWeb-Edu tokens) with the same seed, data and hyperparameters under 9 data-parallel and expert-parallel layouts, in fp32 on CPUs and fp16 on a GPU, and compare each run with the effect of a new random seed. Across 80 runs we find: (1) The layout does not change model quality, but it does change the model: final predictions differ about 80% as much as with a new seed, and over 90% of routing decisions differ. Any layout, a one-bit change to one weight, or a different CPU thread count has the same effect. (2) The cause is the router: decisions that flip are almost exactly those where two experts were nearly tied (AUC 0.97 to 1.00 in the first 16 steps). (3) More, smaller experts create more near-ties (2.7% with 8 experts, 23% with 64) and less reproducible routing (68% vs. 100% of decisions differ), but outputs do not drift further. (4) A dense model of the same active size is far more stable (0.12x the seed level in fp32, 0.58x in fp16), while the MoE reaches about 0.8x at both precisions and twice as fast. (5) When pretraining resumes on a new layout, timing matters: switching at 84% of pretraining barely changes the final model, while switching at 10%, just after warm-up, changes it substantially. We release code, run logs and data.
original_abstract.source_title: MoE Pretraining:Parallelism Layout Changes the Model, Not Quality

en.text: The paper studies how data- and expert-parallel layouts affect MoE training reproducibility. Across 80 small-model runs, changing layout substantially changes routing and predictions without a corresponding quality change in the evaluated settings. Near-ties in expert selection amplify arithmetic perturbations; changing layout early in training has more effect than changing it late. Experiments use 25M–117M models and 20M training tokens. This motivates controlling layout when comparing sparse-model experiments, while extrapolation to industrial-scale recommendation remains unverified.

zh.text: 论文研究数据并行、专家并行布局对 MoE 训练复现的影响。80 次小模型运行中，布局变化明显改变路由与预测，却未在所测条件下相应改变质量；专家选择的近似平局会放大数值扰动，训练早期换布局的影响大于后期。实验规模为 25M–117M 参数、20M 训练 token。这提示比较稀疏扩模实验时应控制并行布局，工业推荐规模上的结论仍待验证。

original_abstract.text: LLM-based recommendation agents can search catalogs, inspect products, ask users, and revise rejected recommendations. However, these behaviors are often governed by hand-designed workflows, while existing training methods optimize isolated components such as query rewriting or list ranking rather than the interaction policy as a whole. We present SimRec, a reinforcement learning framework that trains the full interaction policy of a tool-integrated recommendation agent. SimRec introduces two components. A task-anchored user simulator provides feedback on every recommendation: conditioned on the current task need rather than on user profile, and it can be an external LLM or the recommender itself under self-play. A task-aligned reward optimizes the whole trajectory with GRPO, crediting natural retrieval quality and valid tool use alongside the final hit, with training-only target injection to handle sparse hits over large catalogs. On ESCI and Amazon C4, SimRec improves the NDCG@100 of a Qwen3-4B agent from 32.23% to 35.42% and from 22.94% to 24.72%}, outperforming training-free agents on far larger backbones and task-aligned baselines on NDCG. Analysis shows that the trained agent verifies candidates, uses preferences, and recovers from rejected recommendations far more often than its untrained counterpart. Our code is available at this https URL .
original_abstract.source_title: SimRec: Learning to Search, Ask, and Recommend from Simulated Interaction

en.text: SimRec trains the complete search, clarification and recommendation policy of a tool-using agent with reinforcement learning. A task-conditioned simulator supplies feedback, and trajectory rewards include retrieval quality, valid tool use and the final hit; target injection is used only during training to address sparse successes. ESCI and Amazon C4 experiments improve a Qwen3-4B agent over its untrained counterpart and evaluated alternatives. This suggests a way to spend model capacity on useful interaction behavior, but simulated feedback and offline ranking gains are not live-user evidence.

zh.text: SimRec 用强化学习训练推荐智能体完整的搜索、追问和推荐策略。按任务条件运行的用户模拟器提供反馈，轨迹奖励同时考虑检索质量、有效工具调用和最终命中；为缓解命中稀疏，只在训练时注入目标候选。ESCI 与 Amazon C4 实验中，Qwen3-4B 智能体优于未训练版本及所测方案。它说明模型能力可用于改进交互策略，但模拟反馈和离线排序收益不等于真实用户验证。

original_abstract.text: Re-ranking is a crucial stage in recommender systems, yet existing evaluators oversimplify user browsing assumptions and collapse multi-objective signals into a single scalar, limiting their ability to reflect true listwise utility. We propose \textbf{SurvEval}, a listwise evaluator that jointly models user exposure and item value for re-ranking evaluation. We formalize the sequential browsing process as a discrete-time survival model, deriving monotonically decreasing reaching probabilities that capture the cascading structure of user browsing. We further introduce a multi-objective value estimation module with dedicated per-objective prediction heads and uncertainty-based loss weighting to adaptively balance objectives of varying scales and noise levels. Both components are jointly optimized via a unified transformer backbone, and the listwise utility is obtained by summing the position-wise products of reaching probabilities and conditional item value estimates. Extensive experiments on KuaiRand and Avito demonstrate that SurvEval achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art baselines.
original_abstract.source_title: SurvEval: Listwise Re-Ranking Evaluator via Survival-Based Exposure and Multi-Objective Value Modeling

en.text: SurvEval estimates listwise utility by multiplying each position’s reaching probability by its conditional item value, then summing across the list. A discrete-time survival model captures sequential browsing; separate objective heads and uncertainty-based loss weights balance heterogeneous feedback on a shared transformer. KuaiRand and Avito experiments compare evaluation performance against existing baselines. This offers a structured reward or evaluation component for scaled reranking pipelines, while the browsing model remains an assumption and no online lift is demonstrated.

zh.text: SurvEval 将用户到达每个位置的概率与该位置商品的条件价值相乘，再累加得到列表效用。离散时间生存模型刻画顺序浏览，共享 Transformer 上的多目标预测头和不确定性损失权重平衡不同反馈。KuaiRand、Avito 实验比较了评估效果。它可作为大规模重排的奖励或评估组件，但浏览模型仍有假设，论文未证明线上收益。

original_abstract.text: Re-ranking refines the upstream ranked list to maximize listwise user utility. Existing two-stage generator-evaluator methods decouple list generation from list evaluation, leaving the generator without direct access to the listwise utility signal, while scoring-based one-stage methods score items under a fixed upstream permutation context without explicitly searching the permutation space. We propose \textbf{ReAlign}, a reward-guided preference alignment framework that couples a listwise reward model with a candidate-aware autoregressive generator. The reward model decomposes the listwise reward into position-wise contributions, modeling user exposure through a survival-based exposure module and item value through per-objective heads for heterogeneous engagement signals. The generator is trained in two stages: supervised pre-training on logged exposure lists to establish a relevance prior, followed by reward-guided post-training that aligns the generator with the reward model through complementary distribution and ranking alignment over within-pool standardized rewards. Extensive offline experiments show that ReAlign consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines.
original_abstract.source_title: ReAlign: Reward-Guided Preference Alignment for Generative Re-Ranking

en.text: ReAlign couples a candidate-aware autoregressive reranker with a listwise reward model. The reward separates position-wise exposure from item value across engagement objectives. Supervised training first learns from logged lists, then reward-guided post-training aligns both generation distributions and ranking preferences using standardized within-pool rewards. Offline comparisons report improvements over evaluated baselines. The contribution is connecting list generation to an explicit utility signal, which can inform generative ranking systems; online business gains are not established.

zh.text: ReAlign 将候选感知的自回归重排器与列表奖励模型连接起来，奖励按位置拆分曝光概率和多种互动目标下的商品价值。生成器先从日志列表监督学习，再利用候选池内标准化奖励，同时对齐生成分布与排序偏好。离线实验优于所测基线。它为生成式排序接入明确的列表效用信号提供了方法，尚无线上业务收益验证。

original_abstract.text: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) impose substantial KV cache demands from both large multimodal contexts and growing reasoning traces. Low-rank KV compression has emerged as a promising paradigm that stores low-dimensional latents of KV states and can be combined with quantization. However, existing low-rank methods often induce growing predictive policy drift from the dense model when compressing reasoning KV states, resulting in reasoning failures. We identify two key causes of this degradation: calibration-state mismatch between static contexts and on-policy reasoning states, and unequal error sensitivity across KV states. To address these challenges, we propose TraceKV, a training-free low-rank KV compression framework that unifies on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware SVD, and global rank allocation under a single policy-preserving principle, substantially reducing policy-KL divergence during reasoning. Experiments across multiple VLMs and visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate superior accuracy--memory trade-offs, achieving near-lossless reasoning accuracy with 5.64$\times$ KV cache compression when combined with quantization. Optimized low-rank attention kernels further deliver up to 1.83$\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup. Code will be available at this https URL.
original_abstract.source_title: TraceKV: Policy-Preserving Low-Rank KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Vision-Language Models

en.text: TraceKV compresses the key-value cache of reasoning vision-language models without training. It calibrates on states generated by the model’s own reasoning process, weights low-rank approximation by sensitivity, and allocates ranks globally to limit changes in output distributions. Visual reasoning experiments report near-lossless accuracy at 5.64-fold cache compression when combined with quantization, with optimized kernels giving up to 1.83-fold end-to-end decoding speedup. Calibration that follows generated trajectories may inform generative recommendation serving, but recommendation accuracy and speed have not been tested.

zh.text: TraceKV 在无需训练的条件下压缩视觉语言推理模型的键值缓存。它用模型实际生成的推理状态做校准，按敏感程度进行低秩近似，并统一分配各处的秩，减少压缩对输出分布的扰动。视觉推理实验结合量化实现 5.64 倍缓存压缩，精度接近未压缩模型；优化内核的端到端解码加速最高为 1.83 倍。沿实际生成轨迹校准的思路可供生成式推荐服务参考，推荐任务的精度和速度尚未验证。

original_abstract.text: A mixture-of-experts (MoE) language model uses only a few experts per token, so a server can keep most expert weights in CPU memory and copy an expert to the GPU when the router requests it. Recent methods train the router to keep the same experts for several tokens, and treat fewer routing switches as a proxy for fewer copies. We measure the trade-off directly, in a harness that performs and times real CPU-to-GPU copies for OLMoE-1B-7B. On an L40S GPU, every tested policy that holds an expert set fixed and decodes faster than the least-recently-used (LRU) cache increases next-token loss by at least 0.067 nats. A change that leaves every routing decision intact does better: when the cache must evict an expert, evict the one whose next use lies farthest in the future. This rule copies 2.1x fewer experts than LRU at no loss in quality and is within 3.5% of the fewest copies possible. It needs future requests; the next sixteen tokens of demand recover 96% of its reduction, whereas a rule based on counts of past requests recovers 27%.
original_abstract.source_title: Fewer Expert Transfers Without Changing Routing: Expert Eviction for MoE Offloading

en.text: The study measures actual CPU-to-GPU expert transfers for offloaded OLMoE-1B-7B. Holding expert sets fixed can trade faster decoding for higher loss. Keeping routing unchanged and evicting the expert whose next use is farthest away instead reduces copies by 2.1 times versus LRU without quality loss. This is a future-demand oracle: sixteen-token lookahead captures most of its benefit, while a past-count heuristic captures much less. It provides a cache-policy upper bound and design target, not a deployable predictor of future requests.

zh.text: 论文在卸载到 CPU 的 OLMoE-1B-7B 上测量真实专家传输。固定专家集合虽可加快解码，却可能增加损失；保持路由不变、淘汰下次使用最晚的专家，相比 LRU 可将复制次数降至约 1/2.1，且不损失质量。但该规则需要未来请求，前瞻 16 个 token 可获得大部分收益，基于历史计数的规则只能获得较少收益。它提供的是缓存策略的理想参照和设计目标，并非已解决未来需求预测。

original_abstract.text: User behavior trajectory prediction (UBTP) aims to capture how a user's needs evolve over time by predicting the sequence of future interactions from that user's interaction history. Recent generative recommendation (GR) methods address this task through autoregressive generation of semantic IDs (SIDs). However, serial SID decoding couples token generation with behavior state transitions and requires multiple dependent steps per interaction. Discrete item feedback overlooks predictive uncertainty, and teacher-forced training leaves a training-inference gap in trajectory generation. To address these limitations, we propose TraGR, a behavior-aware generative recommendation framework that aligns generation, feedback, and learning with successive user behaviors. Its behavior-level architecture predicts SID tokens in parallel within each interaction and models behavioral transitions through recurrent state updates, with joint SID and item-level supervision. Probability feedback combines the selected behavior with a probability-weighted summary of alternatives to guide subsequent predictions. Relation-aware trajectory learning incorporates collaborative transition signals and later credit assignment into training on model-generated trajectories. Experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that TraGR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across different prediction horizons. Code: this https URL.
original_abstract.source_title: From Tokens to Behaviors: Rethinking Generative Recommendation for User Trajectory Prediction

en.text: TraGR predicts future user interactions at the behavior level: semantic-ID tokens are generated in parallel within an interaction, while recurrent states model transitions between behaviors. Probability-weighted feedback preserves information about alternative items, and trajectory learning uses collaborative transition signals and later credit assignment on model-generated sequences. Four public datasets show gains across prediction horizons. The architecture separates within-item decoding from between-behavior evolution, offering a design for efficient trajectory generation without an established online serving gain.

zh.text: TraGR 以行为为单位预测用户未来交互：同一次交互内并行生成语义 ID token，行为之间用循环状态建模转移；概率加权反馈保留其他候选的信息，并在模型生成的轨迹上结合协同转移信号和后续贡献分配训练。四个公开数据集上的不同预测跨度均报告改善。它将商品内部解码与行为之间的演化分开，为高效轨迹生成提供了架构思路，尚未证明线上服务收益。

original_abstract.text: Expert-parallel Mixture-of-Experts decoding is latency bound: each layer serializes a token exchange, a grouped GEMM over routed experts, and a combine, while only a few tokens per rank are in flight. Prior GC-MoE fused these phases into one persistent, Green-Context-partitioned CUDA Graph on Hopper (SM90) and datacenter Blackwell (SM100). This paper rebuilds the operator for SM120 (compute capability 12.0, e.g. RTX PRO 5000) over PCIe. SM120 exposes block-scaled tensor cores only through warp-level this http URL::mxf8f6f4: no tensor memory, no two-CTA MMA, no cluster multicast. We rebuild the kernel around a swap-AB warp-level block-scaled MMA with FP4 weights in the register A operand and FP8 activations in B, plus SM120-specific mechanisms: scale-byte selection through MMA immediates, a compact-weights path, an adaptive token-tile geometry, an expert-granular streaming dispatch with a batched bulk-pull engine and a 64-bit deduplicating pull cache, full-width BF16 returns drained by resident relay copiers over a position-major arena, and shared experts folded into the compute role. On 8xRTX PRO 5000 over PCIe the operator is 1.522x and 1.387x faster than the FlashInfer CuTe DSL W4A8 MegaMoE and the Cake MegaMoE across 18 decode points (18/18 wins each), and 1.388x faster than Cake with shared experts fused; all 94 numerical cases and 752 per-rank checks pass, at cross-operator cosine similarity of at least 0.9999997.
original_abstract.source_title: GC-MoE on SM120: Overlapping Expert-Parallel Token Dispatch with Warp-Level FP8xFP4 Block-Scaled MMA on Consumer Blackwell

en.text: GC-MoE adapts a persistent fused dispatch-compute-combine operator to SM120 consumer Blackwell GPUs over PCIe. It overlaps expert token transfers with warp-level FP8-activation/FP4-weight matrix multiplication and uses hardware-specific buffering and synchronization. Eight-RTX-PRO-5000 operator benchmarks outperform the evaluated MegaMoE implementations across 18 decode points, with numerical checks reported. The result is a hardware-specific kernel improvement relevant to sparse serving; it is not an end-to-end recommendation throughput measurement.

zh.text: GC-MoE 将持续执行的分发、计算、合并融合算子适配到通过 PCIe 连接的 SM120 消费级 Blackwell GPU，重叠专家 token 传输与 FP8 激活、FP4 权重矩阵乘法，并针对硬件设计缓冲和同步。八张 RTX PRO 5000 的算子测试在 18 个解码点上优于所测 MegaMoE 实现，并报告数值检查。这是稀疏服务可借鉴的硬件内核优化，不是推荐端到端吞吐测量。

original_abstract.text: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block, offering a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling. However, most existing works directly reuse each loop's output as the next's input, which can lead to hidden-state scale growth and perturbation amplification as recurrence deepens. We propose Rectified Looped Transformer (RLT), which redesigns feedback between loops using an interpolation schedule inspired by flow-based modeling. At each loop, RLT forms the next input by linearly interpolating between the current state and its prediction. Such interpolation distributes state changes across loops, encouraging a smoother trajectory from the initial input to the final output. Theoretical analysis proves that, under appropriate assumptions, RLT keeps state magnitudes uniformly bounded across loops and reduces the worst-case perturbation amplification. We evaluate RLT on language modeling corpora and downstream benchmarks. At matched training and inference depths, RLT consistently achieves lower perplexity than a standard looped Transformer, while exhibiting greater robustness to input perturbations and variance in inference depth. Consistent with the theoretical results, latent trajectory analysis shows that RLT maintains more stable hidden-state norms across loops, which also facilitates extrapolation-based decoding strategies. Notably, RLT achieves these gains without requiring additional trainable parameters or extra recurrent block evaluations, thus providing a simple yet more stable feedback mechanism for looped Transformers.
original_abstract.source_title: Rectified Looped Transformer

en.text: Rectified Looped Transformer interpolates between the current state and its prediction when forming the next loop input, smoothing the trajectory of repeated shared-block computation. Its bounded-state and perturbation-amplification results require stated assumptions. At matched training and inference depths, language-model experiments report lower perplexity and greater robustness than a standard looped Transformer without extra trainable parameters or recurrent block evaluations. This offers a feedback design to test in loop-scaled ranking models; recommendation gains are not established.

zh.text: Rectified Looped Transformer 在当前状态与预测状态之间插值，形成下一轮共享模块的输入，让循环计算的状态变化更平滑。状态有界和扰动放大受控的理论结论依赖论文给定假设。在训练与推理深度匹配时，语言模型实验报告了更低的困惑度和更好的稳健性，且不增加可训练参数或循环模块调用次数。这为循环扩展排序模型提供了可测试的反馈设计，推荐收益仍待验证。

original_abstract.text: Generative recommendation typically operates under the User-Induced Recommendation (UIR) setting, predicting target items by autoregressively generating semantic IDs as a passive continuation of long-term user history. However, this paradigm overlooks Trigger-Induced Recommendation (TIR), an essential industrial scenario where a user click triggers an immediate follow-up feed. In TIR, recommendations must dynamically align with the instant trigger intent without compromising historical preference continuity. Traditional TIR methods rely on discriminative scoring and cannot guide token-level generation, while existing generative models lack mechanisms to reconcile this structural tension. To address this challenge, we propose TriGen, establishing a tailored generative paradigm for trigger-induced recommendation. TriGen introduces calibrated tail injection to re-encode local history, adaptively arbitrates between persistent tastes and immediate impulses via dynamic gating, and applies position-specific transformations to sustain level-aware trigger guidance across decoding steps. Extensive offline evaluations confirm consistent gains over competitive baselines. Furthermore, online A/B tests across six country markets demonstrate significant revenue and GMV improvements, leading to the full production deployment of TriGen.
original_abstract.source_title: TriGen: A Generative Paradigm for Trigger-Induced Recommendation

en.text: TriGen adapts generative recommendation to feeds opened immediately after a user clicks an item. It re-encodes recent history with calibrated trigger injection, uses a dynamic gate to balance persistent preferences and immediate intent, and applies position-specific guidance during semantic-ID decoding. Offline comparisons and online A/B tests across six country markets report gains, followed by production deployment. This provides a mechanism for conditioning a shared generative recommender on short-lived intent; it does not establish a model-size scaling law.

zh.text: TriGen 面向用户点击商品后立即打开的后续推荐流。它将触发信息校准后注入近期历史，用动态门控平衡长期偏好与即时意图，再按解码位置持续引导语义 ID 生成。论文报告离线比较和六个国家市场的线上 A/B 收益，并已部署。它为生成式推荐适配短时意图提供了机制，没有建立模型规模的扩展规律。

original_abstract.text: Generative recommendation (GR) represents items with discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) and casts retrieval as sequence generation. Under skewed interaction distributions and tight serving budgets, GR struggles to retrieve long-tail items. In this work, we are the first to study long-tail reachability across the complete pipeline of SID construction, decoding, and matching. We find that under equal code lengths, parallel SID construction consistently outperforms sequential SIDs on tail items. Moreover, even when full generation fails, decoded sequences carry locally consistent information that retrieves relevant tail items via partial matching. Yet this recovery is bounded by upstream search, failing once beam search prunes all prefixes completable within a fixed mismatch tolerance. Motivated by these findings, we propose ReSID to jointly preserve and recover tail candidates. Built on long parallel SIDs, ReSID pairs popularity-debiased and user-semantic-aware beam search to keep promising paths alive with partial SID matching to recover items from surviving tokens. ReSID achieves state-of-the-art long-tail retrieval while maintaining competitive overall accuracy, with lower latency and higher throughput under narrow beams. ReSID is deployed in our production system, serving main user traffic with substantial business gains. We release our complete code and model checkpoints to support full reproducibility and real-world deployment at this https URL.
original_abstract.source_title: ReSID: Rethinking Long-Tail Retrieval in Generative Recommendation through Item Reachability

en.text: ReSID studies whether long-tail items remain reachable throughout semantic-ID construction, decoding and matching. Parallel IDs, popularity-debiased and user-semantic-aware beam search preserve promising paths, while partial matching recovers items from surviving tokens. Experiments report strong tail retrieval, competitive overall accuracy and better latency and throughput under narrow beams; the paper also reports production deployment and business gains. The method offers a concrete way to allocate limited decoding work without prematurely losing tail candidates; partial matching cannot recover paths already eliminated upstream.

zh.text: ReSID 检查长尾商品在语义 ID 构造、解码和匹配全过程中是否仍有机会被找回。它结合并行 ID、去流行度偏置及用户语义感知的束搜索保留候选路径，再用部分匹配从幸存 token 中恢复商品。论文报告长尾召回改善、总体准确率保持竞争力，窄束宽下延迟和吞吐更好，并已生产部署取得业务收益。它为有限解码预算下保留长尾候选提供了具体方案，但部分匹配无法恢复已被上游完全剪掉的路径。

original_abstract.text: Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), yet accurate FP4 quantization remains challenging. Practical formats such as MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4 pair a 4-bit floating-point payload with block-wise or hierarchical scale codes, making accuracy highly sensitive to how each local distribution is scaled. Default maximum-absolute-value scaling preserves dynamic range, but can spend scarce FP4 levels on rarely occupied outlier regions and leave dense tensor values poorly resolved. Existing scale-search methods minimize local element-wise reconstruction error, optimizing tensor fidelity rather than layer-output fidelity. We propose SoScale, a second-order weight scale-code search method for hierarchical FP4 quantization. SoScale searches hardware-valid scale codes under a Hessian-aware layer reconstruction objective and couples this search with GPTQ-style error recovery, selecting scales by their impact on layer outputs. Across Qwen3 models, SoScale consistently reduces downstream quantization degradation under MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4.
original_abstract.source_title: SoScale: Second-Order Scale Search for FP4 Quantization

en.text: SoScale chooses hardware-valid FP4 scale codes by their effect on layer outputs instead of only minimizing elementwise tensor reconstruction error. It combines a Hessian-aware objective with GPTQ-style error recovery for hierarchical four-bit floating-point formats. Qwen3 experiments report reduced downstream quantization degradation across MXFP4, NVFP4 and HiF4. The transferable idea is to optimize quantization scales against the computation that consumes the weights; neither ranking quality nor recommendation-serving speed is established by these language-model experiments.

zh.text: SoScale 按量化对层输出的影响选择硬件允许的 FP4 尺度编码，而不只比较张量逐元素的重建误差。它结合考虑曲率的目标与 GPTQ 式误差补偿，在 Qwen3 实验中减轻 MXFP4、NVFP4 和 HiF4 格式的下游精度损失。可借鉴点是让尺度选择对准权重实际参与的计算；语言模型上的结果尚不能证明推荐排序质量或服务速度收益。

original_abstract.text:
Search engines and Large Language Models (LLMs) offer complementary strengths for document retrieval: lexical retrievers which rely on keyword matching are fast and energy-efficient, whereas LLMs capture semantic meaning and excel at interpreting long, context-rich queries. However, this comes at a cost that is computationally and energetically prohibitive.
We propose the LLM Active Approximation Model (LAAM), a hybrid retrieval framework that introduces a lightweight learned predictor which serves as an intermediary between semantic retrieval and LLM retrieval. LAAM is refined through an active learning loop where an LLM labels a small number of documents. By concentrating LLM evaluations on the most informative documents, the framework substantially reduces inference cost while preserving retrieval effectiveness.
We evaluate the proposed framework on TREC Robust 2004 using Lucene with BM25 retrieval and DeepSeek v3 as the LLM, under three levels of query verbosity. For verbose queries, LAAM achieves 87% of average P@10 achieved by DeepSeek's reranking (0.459 vs. 0.526), while requiring only 3.3% of the per-query energy consumption. LAAM is statistically significantly better than BM25 and is indistinguishable from DeepSeek on average precision, though not on MAP (Friedman test, P<0.05 with post-hoc testing).
Overall, our results demonstrate that selectively approximating LLM relevance judgments through active learning enables retrieval accuracy to be controlled directly through the evaluation (and consequently energy) budget. Rather than committing to either inexpensive (and less accurate) lexical retrieval or exhaustive (and expensive) LLM reranking, our framework exposes a continuous spectrum of operating points along the energy--accuracy curve, allowing practitioners to select how to trade retrieval quality with computational budget.
original_abstract.source_title: Active Learning of Approximate LLM Ranking for Energy-Efficient Retrieval of Long Queries

en.text: LAAM uses active learning to approximate expensive LLM relevance judgments with a lightweight predictor. It requests labels for informative documents rather than reranking every candidate with the large model. On TREC Robust 2004 with verbose queries, it reaches 87% of DeepSeek v3’s P@10 with 3.3% of its per-query energy use; comparisons vary by ranking metric. The framework exposes a retrieval quality-energy tradeoff useful for compute allocation, but its evidence is limited to the evaluated retrieval setup rather than recommendation deployment.

zh.text: LAAM 用主动学习训练轻量预测器近似昂贵的大模型相关性判断，只请大模型标注信息量较高的文档。在 TREC Robust 2004 的冗长查询设置中，它以 DeepSeek v3 每查询能耗的 3.3% 达到其 P@10 的 87%，不同排序指标上的比较结论并不相同。该方法为检索计算分配提供了质量与能耗的权衡，证据限于所测检索环境，尚非推荐部署结果。

original_abstract.text:
Recommender systems, which retrieve items of interest to users based on their interaction histories, have recently witnessed several key technological advancements, benefiting from the semantic representation space and model-data scaling. Nevertheless, practitioners and researchers have frequently encountered critical inconsistencies between simple offline evaluations and complex online results, and this gap still exists in the era of large models. In this work, we address several key factors that contribute to this inconsistency: 1) the \textit{large-scale continual learning challenge} that assumes a practical demand to maintain long-term model effectiveness under dynamic item pools and distributional shifts; 2) the \textit{combinatorial diversity challenge} that requires the generation strategy to solve the accuracy-diversity trade-off in both the finer token level and the holistic item level; and 3) the \textit{multi-task reward balancing challenge}, which is particularly critical for modern generative models that can accurately model the sequence distribution but are less controllable for the multi-task demands.
To address these challenges and further pave the way for the development of more realistic recommendation solutions, we introduce KuaiRecV2, a deliberately constructed benchmark with industrial-level datasets from Kuaishou. Specifically, we provide a large-scale interaction dataset with million-scale multi-modal item information and long-term interaction records across 30 days, with a dynamic video candidate pool. Additionally, we provide a rigorous benchmark that evaluates retrieval accuracy, diversity, and multi-task performance in one rubric system, where an effective advancement occurs if and only if the new method improves all metrics. The code is available at this https URL
original_abstract.source_title: KuaiRecV2: Benchmarking Large-Scale Continual Learning for Diversified and Multi-task Recommendation

en.text: KuaiRecV2 evaluates recommendation under continual learning, diversity and multi-task demands. Its industrial dataset combines million-scale multimodal items, 30 days of interactions and a changing video candidate pool. The benchmark jointly measures retrieval accuracy, diversity and task performance instead of treating a single offline score as sufficient progress. This provides a more realistic setting for testing scaled recommendation models under distribution shifts; it is a benchmark contribution, not evidence that a particular model improves online outcomes.

zh.text: KuaiRecV2 面向持续学习、多样性和多任务推荐评估，提供百万量级多模态商品信息、30 天交互记录及动态视频候选池。评估同时考察召回准确率、多样性和任务表现，避免用单项离线分数代表整体进步。它为检验扩模后的推荐系统如何应对分布变化提供了更贴近业务的环境，贡献在于基准，而非证明某个模型已有线上收益。

original_abstract.text: Second-order optimizers (e.g., Shampoo, SOAP) have emerged as compelling alternatives to Adam/AdamW and promise faster per-step convergence than AdamW in transformer training. However, they still remain costly in practice, and even SOAP still pays substantial optimizer-state memory and eigendecomposition overhead. We ask whether the benefits of SOAP can be retained at nearly the efficiency of AdamW. In this paper, we answer yes with a lightweight SOAP variant, Factored One-sided Adam-Moment (FOAM). The path to practical impact is twofold: first, FOAM employs input-only preconditioning, dropping the output-side Kronecker factor to reduce memory and remove one eigendecomposition. The Kronecker structure of the Hessian shows that this is exact for a diagonal output-side curvature and nearly lossless for a near-diagonal one, as we observe empirically. Second, FOAM replaces SOAP's dense rotated second moment with a factored Adam-moment estimator based on row-by-column statistics. Under the K-FAC Fisher assumption with a diagonal output curvature, this estimator exactly recovers SOAP's dense second moment, and we measure only a 15-20% K-FAC violation, with negligible effect on the update. Our empirical results support the claim that FOAM matches strong SOAP and Muon baselines in validation loss across scales of large language model (LLM) pre-training, uses half of SOAP's optimizer state, runs at Muon-class wall-clock time, and retains robustness across a three-fold learning-rate range. The results hold from 124M to 760M parameters, demonstrating that SOAP's gains need not require SOAP's cost. Code: this https URL
original_abstract.source_title: Factored One-sided Adam-Moment for Practical and Scalable SOAP

en.text: FOAM reduces the optimizer-state and matrix-decomposition costs of SOAP through input-side-only preconditioning and a row-by-column factorization of the rotated second moment. Its exact equivalence claims require stated curvature and Fisher assumptions. In language-model pretraining from 124M to 760M parameters, it matches strong SOAP and Muon baselines in validation loss while using half of SOAP’s optimizer state and reporting Muon-class wall-clock time. This offers an optimizer design to evaluate when scaling ranking models under memory limits; the experiments do not establish recommendation gains.

zh.text: FOAM 从两处降低 SOAP 优化器的成本：只保留输入侧预条件处理，并用行、列统计分解旋转后的二阶矩，减少状态存储和矩阵分解。理论上的精确等价依赖论文给定的曲率与 Fisher 假设。124M–760M 参数语言模型预训练中，验证损失接近强 SOAP、Muon 基线，优化器状态为 SOAP 的一半，运行时间与 Muon 同量级。它提供了在显存约束下扩展排序模型时可评估的优化器设计，推荐收益仍需实验。

original_abstract.text:
Recommendation and Ranking (R&R) models, particularly in digital advertising, require massive inference throughput but exhibit extreme sensitivity to precision loss. Unlike Large Language Models (LLMs) that frequently tolerate quantization-induced accuracy drops of 1% or more, production-grade R&R models enforce a stringent launch bar: model quality must remain within a 0.01% Normalized Entropy (NE) margin relative to the baseline, which commonly uses FP16 or FP32. This tight constraint has historically hindered the adoption of aggressive quantization in this domain. In this paper, we present an empirical evaluation of both MXFP8 and the 6-bit MXFP6 format for industrial-scale R&R inference on the AMD MI350X architecture.
  To the best of our knowledge, this is the first paper, across R&R and LLM domains, that reports significant speedups from native MXFP6 GEMMs, which quantize both weights and activations and compute directly on 6-bit elements, without sacrificing model quality. We demonstrate that we can selectively apply this 6-bit format to maximize overall QPS gain without breaching the strict NE parity threshold. We further show that MXFP8 is a viable alternative to row-wise FP8: the two formats have nearly the same accuracy on our models, so the faster kernel can be chosen for each GEMM shape. On two production ads ranking models, our implementation shows measured GEMM kernel speedups over FP16 of 1.33--1.55x for MXFP8 and 1.73--1.99x for MXFP6 across all supported linear layers, and up to 2.90x for MXFP6 on individual layers, alongside end-to-end (E2E) inference throughput gains from selective MXFP6 of 1.5--5.3% for Model A and 7.6--14.3% for Model B over their FP8 configurations.
original_abstract.source_title: Advancing Quantization for R&R Models with Microscaling Formats

en.text: This study evaluates MXFP8 and native MXFP6 weight-and-activation quantization for two production ads-ranking models on AMD MI350X under a 0.01% normalized-entropy quality margin. Selective MXFP6 improves end-to-end throughput over the models’ FP8 configurations by 1.5–5.3% for Model A and 7.6–14.3% for Model B. Kernel speedups over FP16 are larger and should not be confused with system gains. The practical lesson for ranking scaling is to choose precision by layer and matrix shape under an explicit quality budget, rather than assume every layer tolerates six bits.

zh.text: 这项研究在 AMD MI350X 上评估两个生产广告排序模型的 MXFP8 与原生 MXFP6 权重、激活量化，质量约束是归一化熵相对基线的差距不超过 0.01%。选择性使用 MXFP6 后，相对各模型的 FP8 配置，端到端吞吐在模型 A 上提高 1.5%–5.3%，模型 B 上提高 7.6%–14.3%。单个矩阵运算内核相对 FP16 的加速更大，不能混作整机收益。可借鉴的方法是在明确质量预算下按层和矩阵形状选择精度，避免假定所有层都能承受六比特量化。

original_abstract.text: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures activate only a subset of experts for each token, allowing large language models (LLMs) to scale parameter capacity without a proportional increase in computation per token. However, intermediate data movement and uneven expert loads limit the efficiency of MoE inference on TPUs. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce Fuse-All MoE, a TPU kernel design that jointly optimizes expert computation, output communication, and load balancing. The kernel fuses token collection, expert projections, gated activation, and output writes, retaining expert computation intermediates on chip. Fixed token-slot destinations allow scheduling and expert placement to change while preserving routing semantics. In prefill-decode (PD) disaggregated serving, Fuse-All MoE balances EP16 prefill workloads through scheduling and expert redistribution, while symmetric EP8TP2 shares active expert computation between the two TensorCore devices within each chip during decode. Our experiments show that Fuse-All MoE reduces kernel runtime for a measured skewed EP16 prefill workload from 2.3x to 1.09x the same fixed reference time for a balanced workload. Across 32-512 decode tokens, symmetric EP8TP2 reduces kernel latency by up to 21.3% relative to fused EP16. With accompanying serving stack optimizations, the integrated system improves serving throughput by up to 34.5% over the Megablox EP16 baseline.
original_abstract.source_title: Fuse-All MoE Inference Kernel with Load Balancing on TPUs

en.text: Fuse-All MoE combines token collection, expert projections, gated activation and output writes in one TPU kernel, keeping intermediates on chip while preserving routing semantics across scheduling and placement changes. On 32–512 decode tokens, symmetric EP8TP2 reduces kernel latency by up to 21.3% versus fused EP16. The integrated serving system, including additional stack optimizations, improves throughput by up to 34.5% over Megablox EP16. Its transferable lesson for sparse ranking models is to optimize memory traffic and expert imbalance together; these are TPU LLM results, not demonstrated recommendation gains.

zh.text: Fuse-All MoE 将 token 收集、专家投影、门控激活和输出写入合并到一个 TPU 内核，让中间结果留在芯片内，并在调度和专家放置变化时保持路由语义。32–512 个解码 token 的测试中，EP8TP2 相对融合 EP16 的内核延迟最多降低 21.3%；包含其他服务栈优化的完整系统，相对 Megablox EP16 的吞吐最多提高 34.5%。对稀疏排序模型的借鉴是同时处理数据搬运与专家负载不均；这些结果来自 TPU 上的语言模型，不能直接当作推荐收益。

original_abstract.text: Generative recommendation benefits from long interaction histories, but the cost of processing them directly grows with history length. We propose RecMem, a recurrent memory compression framework guided by three desiderata: space invariance, semantic fidelity, and lifelong evolvability. RecMem compresses historical segments into a fixed set of memory slots using a bifurcated encoder-decoder with shared lower layers and slot-wise forget-gated updates. Recommendation supervision trains the memory to preserve predictive information, while stream-consistency training aligns predictions from sequential and packed processing. By construction, the memory state and decoder context are independent of history length; under contraction and approximate semigroup consistency, we further derive a horizon-independent bound on the state discrepancy between these two processing orders. On MerRec, RecMem uses 16 memory slots and a 216-token decoder context, compared with 1,200 tokens for HSTU-1200, while retaining 87.9% of HSTU-1200's Recall@10 and 97.0% of its Recall@200. It outperforms PHSTU and the evaluated recent-only and retrieval baselines, and analyses of distant history show that archived interactions contribute predictive signal.
original_abstract.source_title: RecMem: Recurrent Memory Compression for Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation

en.text: RecMem compresses historical behavior segments into fixed memory slots with shared encoder-decoder layers and slot-wise forget gates; stream-consistency training aligns sequential and packed processing. On MerRec, 16 slots and a 216-token decoder context retain 87.9% of HSTU-1200’s Recall@10 and 97.0% of its Recall@200, versus its 1,200-token context. The rollout discrepancy bound requires contraction and approximate semigroup consistency. This offers a concrete memory-budget tradeoff for long-history generative recommendation, with some recall loss relative to the full-context baseline.

zh.text: RecMem 将历史行为分段写入固定数量的记忆槽，通过共享编码器与解码器底层、逐槽遗忘门和流式一致性训练，保留有助于预测的信息。在 MerRec 上，16 个记忆槽、216 个解码上下文 token 保留了 HSTU-1200 的 87.9% Recall@10 和 97.0% Recall@200，后者使用 1,200 个上下文 token。误差界依赖收缩性与近似半群一致性假设。它为长历史生成式推荐提供了明确的内存与召回率取舍，相对完整上下文基线仍有召回损失。

original_abstract.text: Efficient sequential recommendation has emerged as a promising paradigm for providing real-time personalized service. To deploy models under resource-constrained environment, model compression becomes a necessity, yet existing methods typically apply uniform compression ratios, overlooking the heterogeneity in user intent complexity. This "one-size-fits-all" approach leads to a fundamental Capacity-Complexity Mismatch, where computational resources are either wasted on simple instances or insufficient for complex ones. To address this, we propose RACE (Ranking-uncertainty Aware Capacity-Adaptive Customization for Efficient Sequential Recommendation), a framework that dynamically adapts both model structures and input sequences with uncertainty-aware compression ratios. To ensure capacity-adaptive inference, RACE captures the model's intrinsic uncertainty of its predictions and transforms it into a proactive resource allocator. Specifically, we derive a list-wise ranking-uncertainty metric from the distributional stability of top-$K$ predictions, which serves as a measurable proxy for instance complexity. A lightweight predictor is then trained via self-supervision to anticipate this uncertainty from early-layer features. Guided by this signal, RACE performs instance-specific slimming in two dimensions: a hypernetwork-style channel sensitivity extractor identifies parameter redundancy, while importance-aware progressive sequence filtering mitigates data redundancy. Extensive experiments on four popular datasets demonstrate that RACE outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on accuracy, efficiency, and adaptability.
original_abstract.source_title: RACE: Ranking-Uncertainty Aware Capacity-Adaptive Customization for Efficient Sequential Recommendation

en.text: RACE uses the stability of top-K prediction distributions as a proxy for instance complexity, then predicts this ranking uncertainty from early-layer features. It adapts both model channels and input-history length through channel sensitivity estimation and progressive sequence filtering. Experiments on four datasets report better accuracy, efficiency and adaptability than the evaluated baselines. This suggests a way to allocate recommendation inference capacity by request difficulty; the abstract does not establish production-scale CTR gains.

zh.text: RACE 用前 K 个预测结果的分布稳定性衡量排序不确定性，再从浅层特征预测这一信号，估计每次请求的复杂程度。它据此同时裁减模型通道和历史序列，以通道敏感度估计与渐进式序列筛选分配推理资源。四个数据集上的实验报告了相对所评估基线的准确率、效率和适应性优势。可借鉴之处是按请求难度分配推荐模型容量；摘要没有证明生产规模的 CTR 收益。

original_abstract.text: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models add parameters without proportionally increasing per-token compute. However, training cost also depends on bytes moved, memory held, and kernels launched, and many of those costs follow total parameter size rather than active compute. On infrastructure built for dense models, this mismatch is costly: in early baselines, throughput fell as stored expert parameter size grew, even though the useful work per token stayed nearly fixed. To close this gap, we present a redesigned training stack in Olmo-core, built for efficient, scalable MoE training. We replace the Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) of earlier Olmo-core versions with an architecture built on Distributed Data Parallel (DDP), and add Expert Parallelism (EP), Pipeline Parallelism (PP), a distributed optimizer, and activation recompute. We propose NVSHMEM-based rowwise EP, which writes each token directly into its expert's buffer, avoiding dispatch and combine permutation overhead. We make EP fully synchronization-free by keeping routing metadata on the GPU and using device-scheduled grouped GEMMs. Closely integrated MXFP8 cuts compute, activation-memory, and transport costs, and topology-agnostic checkpoints let the parallel layout change between runs. On NVL8 B300 nodes, the stack supports training configurations from 12.9 billion to 1.2 trillion total parameters on up to 512 GPUs, reaching 858 useful-model TFLOP/s/GPU at 1.2 trillion with MXFP8 and per-layer recompute; an experimental capacity test with the optional DeepEP v2 backend reaches 2.38 trillion. We also explain each design choice and share findings for other training systems; for example, we identify a failure pattern we call Token Gerrymandering, in which the MoE router can learn to hack the load-balancing loss, and find that overlapping communication with computation can slow the overlapped kernels by more than it hides.
original_abstract.source_title: Supercharging Olmo-core for Efficient and Scalable MoE Training

en.text: The redesigned Olmo-core training stack combines expert and pipeline parallelism, a distributed optimizer, activation recomputation and MXFP8. Rowwise expert parallelism writes tokens directly into expert buffers, while GPU-resident routing metadata removes host synchronization. On B300 nodes it supports 12.9B–1.2T parameter configurations on up to 512 GPUs, reporting 858 useful-model TFLOP/s/GPU at 1.2T with MXFP8 and per-layer recomputation. The transferable insight for sparse ranking training is that total expert parameters drive memory and communication costs even when active computation stays fixed; the reported measurements are language-model training results.

zh.text: 重构后的 Olmo-core 将专家并行、流水线并行、分布式优化器、激活重计算与 MXFP8 配合使用。逐行专家并行把 token 直接写入专家缓冲区，路由元数据留在 GPU 上，减少重排和主机同步。在 B300 节点、最多 512 张 GPU 上，它支持 12.9B–1.2T 参数配置；1.2T 参数、MXFP8 和逐层重计算条件下报告每张 GPU 858 useful-model TFLOP/s。对稀疏排序训练的启发是：即使激活计算量不变，专家总参数仍会推高存储与通信成本；这些测量来自语言模型训练。

original_abstract.text: Sequence models represent past context at different resolutions, using token-level keys and values, fixed-size recurrent states, or hierarchies of compressed summaries. Full attention supports strong associative recall but requires quadratic work during training and prefill and a linearly growing key-value cache during inference. Linear attention and state-space models reduce these costs through fixed-size recurrent memory, but this compression can limit recall. Log-linear attention offers a middle ground by maintaining logarithmically many state matrices. However, its hierarchy favors finer resolution near the current query while compressing earlier context into coarser summaries. To complement this allocation of resolution, we introduce bilateral log-linear attention, which pairs the existing hierarchy with a second hierarchy anchored at the sequence origin. By combining their reads, the two branches provide finer access to both early and recent context while remaining causal. We derive recurrent and chunkwise parallel formulations for the added branch, preserving log-linear training and prefill work, logarithmic decoding work per token, and logarithmic persistent state storage at fixed feature dimensions and chunk size. In multi-query associative recall, this design raises mean overall test accuracy from 76.37% to 96.12% over forward log-linear attention across multiple training seeds. For pretrained language models under approximate parameter matching, it raises the mean score on six selected RULER needle-in-a-haystack tasks from 26.97% to 50.03% at a context length of 6144 tokens. In the same setting, bilateral attention also outperforms forward log-linear attention on seven of eight downstream retrieval tasks, including question answering and information extraction.
original_abstract.source_title: Bilateral Log-Linear Attention

en.text: Bilateral log-linear attention adds a hierarchy anchored at the sequence origin to the existing hierarchy favoring recent context, improving access to both early and recent tokens while remaining causal. At fixed feature dimensions and chunk size, it preserves log-linear training/prefill work and logarithmic per-token decoding work and persistent state. Under approximate parameter matching, mean performance on six selected RULER tasks at 6,144 tokens rises from 26.97% to 50.03% relative to forward log-linear attention. This motivates testing dual-resolution memory for long behavior histories; recommendation benefits remain unverified.

zh.text: 双侧对数线性注意力在偏向近期上下文的层级记忆之外，增加从序列起点建立的第二套层级，让早期和近期 token 都有较细粒度的读取路径，同时保持因果性。在特征维度和分块大小固定时，训练与预填充计算保持对数线性增长，逐 token 解码计算及持久状态保持对数增长。参数量近似匹配、上下文为 6,144 token 时，六项选定 RULER 任务的平均分从单向方案的 26.97% 提高到 50.03%。这一设计可用于探索长行为历史的记忆分配，推荐收益尚未验证。
